correctness.rationale: The equivariant deleted cubical complex is valid for n>=5. The integral H2 face-product classes have zero boundary and a diagonal unit coefficient minor; established planar H2 rank makes them an integral basis. The full symmetry action follows from global facial orientation and antisymmetry. Signed cellular Lefschetz, whose all-parameter modular indicator sum is explicitly supplied, yields H1 characters. Rational transfer gives the quotient ranks. Program checks every group element for n=4..18 and integral cycles/rank for n=4..10; finite checks do not replace the general proof.

The all-n group-character formulas and the contrast between polygon-dihedral and full layer-swap orbit-space rational homology determine substantive extra topological structure and support future quotient-space and equivariant braid comparisons.
